    Goodness of fit for a bivariate NB model

    bnb_gof.Rd

    Reports log-likelihood, AIC, BIC, and four pseudo-R-squared measures (McFadden, McFadden adjusted, Cox-Snell, Nagelkerke) relative to an intercept-only null model refit with the same dependence structure.

    Usage

    bnb_gof(fit, digits = 4, print_output = TRUE)

    Arguments

    fit

    A bnb_fit object from fit_bnb().

    digits

    Number of decimal places for printed output.

    print_output

    Logical; if FALSE, suppress printing and return the result invisibly.

    Value

    Invisibly, a list with n, k, logLik_full, logLik_null, AIC, BIC, a named numeric vector pseudoR2, and the null_fit.

    Examples

    d <- read.csv(system.file("extdata", "rwm1984_clean.csv", package = "rpbnb"))
fit <- fit_bnb(docvis ~ outwork + age, hospvis ~ outwork, data = d,
               dependence = "famoye")
bnb_gof(fit)
#> 
#> --- Goodness of Fit ---
#> n = 3874, k = 8
#> logLik(full) = -9620.0001
#> AIC = 19256.0001    BIC = 19306.0965
#> 
#> Pseudo R-squared:
#>        Metric  Value
#>      McFadden 0.0095
#>  McFadden_adj 0.0086
#>      CoxSnell 0.0463
#>    Nagelkerke 0.0466
